{{Quote|I spent the last of my savings travelling to Coruscant, where I opened a stand, Dex's Donuts, at the corner of Zevanth Street and Avenue Peth.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Avenue Peth''' was a street on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] first arrived on the planet, he opened a small [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] shop called [[Dex's Donuts]] on the corner of [[Zevanth Street]] and Avenue Peth.<ref name="Dex" /> By [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Dining at Dex's]]" establishes that Dex's Donuts closed before [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] purchased [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The Trail of the Jedi]]'', by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of which Jettster already owned [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]], to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]. Therefore, Dex's Donuts must have closed at some point by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> however, an [[Unidentified air taxi driver|air taxi driver]] crashed and destroyed Dex's Donuts, forcing Jettster to close the corner storefront. He later recounted owning Dex's Donuts in the menu of his next Coruscant [[Restaurant/Legends|establishment]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. Avenue Peth shared its name with<ref name="Dex" /> [[Peth/Legends|Peth]], a letter in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Writing/Legends|alphabet]].<ref name="TWW">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Avenue Peth was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" />
